FT-002.adaptation: Accepted FT-002 rev 11: one measured output allocation or reuse improvement with exact clean equivalence. Rev 10 isolated the phases, so I am targeting a measured allocation in the output path rather than guessing: the direct page renderer still allocates a String per item for the font hint via json::write(font_json(..)), which is 96571 allocations on the pinned fixture when font-hints-v1 is negotiated, and the reply buffer reservation is roughly twice the measured bytes per item.

next_action: Rev 12 just dispatched; starting it now.

origin/main.adaptation: Measured and rejected a second change in the same revision rather than bundling it: resizing the reply reservation from 160 to 96 bytes per item helped the negotiated case and hurt the legacy one, within run-to-run noise either way. Isolating the font literal alone produced a better result than either variant, which is why rev 11 asks for one improvement rather than several.

summary: FT-002 rev 11 delivered: the font hint is now a precomputed literal instead of a Value built and stringified per item. Warm reply with font-hints-v1 cut from 32.601 ms to 16.152 ms p50, a 50 percent reduction, with byte-identical output proven by the pinned fixtures. 16 suites pass.

usage.evidence: warm reply font-hints-v1 p50 32.601 to 16.152 ms and p95 33.655 to 17.007; 96571 per-item allocations removed on the pinned fixture; a test asserts every literal is byte-identical to serialising the structured form; pinned byte-exact fixtures unchanged; 16 suites pass; clippy clean; fmt clean
